title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-30
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a tight 1982 show highlighted by Etta James' double encore of Hard To Handle and Tell Mama.
ai_review.review: The recording offers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets the band’s tight, well‑played set shine. Highlights include the surprise guest appearance by Etta James for a powerful double encore of Hard To Handle and Tell Mama, plus memorable moments like Billy dancing behind Mickey during his solo on He's Gone. Overall the show bursts with high energy and seamless flow.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong praise for both performance (tight, energetic set) and superb soundboard recording across three reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Superb, clear, crisp sound with no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set moves smoothly, with Feel Like A Stranger sandwiched mid‑first set and a tight second‑set opening; new songs Touch and Throwing Stones find their place.

band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey's drum solo on He's Gone is highlighted, with Billy adding tambourine and dancing behind him.
